pull.title: KAFKA-20125: Improve the docs of dynamic-only configurations
pull.body:
Some broker settings in the static configuration file look valid but do
nothing at runtime. They only work when set dynamically.

Configs covered (`QuotaConfig.BROKER_QUOTA_CONFIGS`):
- leader.replication.throttled.rate
- follower.replication.throttled.rate
- replica.alter.log.dirs.io.max.bytes.per.second
- mirror.replication.throttled.rate

Docs: `QuotaConfig` `*_DOC` strings note that values in the static
configuration file have no effect.

Logs: On broker startup, `BrokerServer.startup` checks static broker
config against `BROKER_QUOTA_CONFIGS` and emits one WARN per matching
key. Dynamic reconfiguration does not re-log these warnings.

Reviewers: Chia-Ping Tsai <chia7712@gmail.com>

repo.name: kafka
repo.description: Apache Kafka - A distributed event streaming platform

review_comments.body: Maybe we could also output a WARN log during startup when users configure them in server.properties
good idea, updated to log a WARN at broker startup when any of these three configs is present in server.properties, thanks!
Should we test all related configs?
`server.properties` is not always correct. Would you mind using `static configuration file` instead?
`warnIfDynamicOnlyBrokerQuotaConfigInServerProperties` is a bit verbose. where is your taste in naming :smile:
the originals contains the dynamic configs, so the warning message would print on every dynamic config change, right?

review_comments.diff_hunk:
@@ -158,6 +158,7 @@ class DynamicBrokerConfig(private val kafkaConfig: KafkaConfig) extends Logging
   private var currentConfig: KafkaConfig = _
 
   private[server] def initialize(clientTelemetryExporterPluginOpt: Option[ClientTelemetryExporterPlugin]): Unit = {
+    KafkaConfig.warnIfDynamicOnlyBrokerQuotaConfigsInStaticConfig(staticBrokerConfigs.asJava)
review_comments.body: Could we log the warnings only if the role is `BROKER`?
It is already in the broker scope, right? If so, this check could be removed.
The method is not in KafkaConfig anymore, so we need to find another place to move it to :)

review_comments.diff_hunk:
@@ -208,6 +208,7 @@ class BrokerServer(
 
       val clientTelemetryExporterPlugin = new ClientTelemetryExporterPlugin()
 
+      config.dynamicConfig.warnIfBrokerQuotaConfigsInStaticConfig()
review_comments.body:
I feel this approach became a bit complex. Maybe we could inline it in BrokerServer.startup right after initialize() and then remove the tests?

```java
      config.dynamicConfig.staticBrokerConfigs.keys
        .filter(QuotaConfig.BROKER_QUOTA_CONFIGS.contains)
        .foreach(name => warn(s"$name is set in the static configuration file but is ignored at runtime; " +
          "configure this property dynamically to take effect."))
```

commit.message: KAFKA-20125: Clarify behavior of dynamic-only broker configs
add test for other two configs, updated naming
KAFKA-20125: Warn for dynamic-only quotas only in static config
Move the startup warning to DynamicBrokerConfig.initialize(), and remove the validateValues() check against originals so dynamic broker reconfiguration does not re-log WARN.
Use BROKER_QUOTA_CONFIGS, warn only for broker role, and move static-config checks into DynamicBrokerConfig.initialize().
Call warnIfBrokerQuotaConfigsInStati Config from BrokerServer.startup before dynamic config initialize
drop redundant check and move test to correct place
